description: Create or update an option (any option, no allow-list: be careful with siteurl, home, active_plugins etc.). A value containing "[masked]" is refused, since writing back a masked read would destroy the stored secret. The echoed value is masked like reads. Note: created is always false (cvrt-mcp-endpoints 1.14.2 checks it after writing).

autoload.description: Load on every page (default true). Only applied when the value changes or the option is new.

key.description: Option name (letters, digits, _ and -; the server lowercases it)

value.description: Option value (any JSON type; arrays/objects are stored serialized). Required.

name: mcp_set_option
